title: Developing the best free photo editor - Ivan KUCKIR - Web2day 2019
summary: Photopea founder Ivan Kutskir talks about developing a free browser-based photo editor, one of the most complex JavaScript programs ever written, and the web technologies behind it.
why: HN points to it as a look under the hood of a remarkable one-developer project.

quote.text: here's a cool talk about it: the whole thing is just 2MB of JS written by one guy!
